label: GO after S2 rewarded, largest when the trial before was unrewarded (fresh S2 reward)
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == -9) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 r")
explanation: Active only at GO (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude is driven by the last trial having reached S2 and been rewarded, modulated by the trial before: largest when the trial before was S1 unrewarded (dev weight ~+0.89), then S2 unrewarded (~+0.52); near zero when the trial before was S2 rewarded (repeated S2 reward: activation decays across consecutive S2 rewards, e.g. 3.0 -> 0.5 -> 0.1) and slightly negative for S1 rewarded. A rare a1->S2 rewarded last trial adds ~+0.35 on top (vs common a2->S2 r). All other previous-trial patterns give ~0. So it signals a fresh reward at S2 (evidence S2 has become/is good, pushing toward a2). Value/policy add nothing beyond these history terms. Uses only observed history. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.44, above the profile all ceiling (0.34); residual misses mostly at window edges where the trial before is unknown.
